title: Does Varying Resistance Exercises Promote Superior Muscle Hypertrophy and Strength Gains? A Systematic Review
key_findings: Varying exercises can change hypertrophy and strength outcomes.
Some systematic variation appears to help regional hypertrophy and maximal dynamic strength, while excessive or random variation may compromise gains.
The authors advise choosing variations for distinct anatomical and biomechanical reasons, and warn that redundant exercises or very frequent rotation may hinder progress.
methods: Systematic review of three databases; study quality rated good to excellent on the PEDro scale; no pooled meta-analysis.
limitations: Eight studies, young men only, qualitative synthesis.

verification.retraction_check: No retraction or correction notice in Crossref updated-by or in the PubMed publication types on 2026-11-25.
